items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Could you talk about your parents? What were their jobs or occupations?
Occupation? They tried to operate that café, and my mother, you know, we had a sister was born, too. She’s still alive—Mariette.
